notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
You all pointed out a lot of improvements that can be made, so this is phase one of those improvements

[b]Energy Changes:[/b]
I have decided to remove the energy gained by destroying ships.
This ended up giving players too much energy to work with and took away any threat of losing ships. It made the lose of a ship meaningless and I want there to be more stress around the loss of an asset. In real combat, the loss of a ship would be significant to any commander. This also allows better story telling through escalation of the fight.

[b]Difficulty Changes:[/b]
The wave progression has been completely redone to be far more achievable at all stages of the game.
Each level will have a different wave progression intended to be completable at first pass by highly skilled players on their first go, but most players will struggle after around wave 30. I believe this will reduce the grindy feeling some players are reporting.

[b]Other Tweaks:[/b]
- Removed the ability to purchase ship levels. This just feels tacked on and I don't like it as a feature,
- Added Surrender button so you can give up if you don't want to wait for your station to die
- Added "Reset All" Button to the upgrade rooms.


[b]Future Plans:[/b]
This is just a first run of the rebalance. I will be monitoring and playtesting it for a couple weeks, and then redoing the upgrades to be more interesting.


Thanks for checking out the game and providing feedback!

notes.title: Big Balance Pass
notes.content:
Several players were reporting the game was too easy... well we cant have that now can we :) this change focuses on encouraging more synergistic fleets as opposed to finding the one OP ship and spamming it

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Enemy ships Tier 3 and above have had HP at least doubled and their DPS significantly increased
- Heavy Destroyer Damage Bonus reduced by 50%, 
- - it is supposed to be a flexible ship with its 6 turrets and the damage was not properly scaled to reflect that
- Artillery Cannon modified to focus on long range damage, so lower damage, longer range
- Ship prices increased
- Cruiser and Battle ship damage and HP buffed

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Main Menu text wont disappear randomly
- Particle effects shouldn't outlive their welcome
- Beating wave 60 should now properly award Savior difficulty

[b]Updates[/b] 
- The game now properly saves your turret layouts upon closing 
- Full screen preferences are saved and loaded properly
- Wave defeated indicator now shows when you have achieved a new high score

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update (0.11.11.1)
notes.content:
[h1]Next Fest Demo Update![/h1]
Check out the latest updates and balance passes as we prep for the excitement of Steam Next Fest.
Here is a high level summary of the changes!

[h2]Feature Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Camera Zoom - Get a closer look at the action!
[*] Swarmers - These ships will spawn occasionally and ignore the path all together, make sure your fleet is flexible!
[*] Node Roaming - Spawn camping is harder now -> *See details farther down
[*] The Loading screen is now an actual loading screen
[*] Blackhole bomb reworked to be more like... well more like a bomb that generates a black hole
[/list]

[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Path Graphics
[*] Visual Effects on Ships with Hull damage to help see what needs attention
[*] New Station Designs for early levels
[/list]

[h2]Balance Tweaks (Or Heavy handed re-works)[/h2]
[list]
[*] All Turret DPS numbers tuned way down
[*] Ship Health reworked to better match cost and remove some OP Combos
[*] Ships Costs changed to allow for more flexible playstyles
[*] Ship unlock points increased for more logical progression
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Accidentally refunding Gun Boat and not having points to rebuy, soft locking players
[*] Pathing through rocks... since that's not cool
[*] The game not giving you upgrade points when it doesn't like you, sorry that one guy
[*] Audio sometimes overlapping and sounding bad
[*] Not being able to unlock the standard cruiser
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new changes, and we look forward to seeing you during next fest! join the discord for access to a special extended demo for a limited time!
[url=https://discord.gg/ZRQH7tjcVh]Discord Link [/url]

Fly Safe Commanders!

notes.title: Demo Build 0.9.6.0 is Live

[*] Added new Voice lines
[*] Added new SFX

[*] Changed to 'Right Click' to confirm ship movements
[*] Added 'Shift' or 'Control' to add ships to a fleet move one by one

[*] Changed Fleet move to detect when a fleet move should allow a ship to move because the blocking ship will be moving out of the way.
[/list]

Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Ship movement Speed Tweaked
[*] Wave progression adjusted to be slightly more difficult
[/list]

Removals:
[list]
[*] Removed Ship Upgrade Points in level

[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed numerous issues with fleet movement
[*] Fixed Audio queue issues causing overlapping dialogue issues
[*] Fixed issue causing up to a 15 minute delay in ship spawning timers
[/list]
